featured_reviews.name: Goat Of Godzilla
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is very good and enjoyable to eat. The vada pav was especially delicious and full of flavor. The soft pav combined perfectly with the crispy vada inside, creating a tasty and satisfying bite. The spices were balanced well, not too strong but still rich and mouthwatering. The chutneys added an extra kick, making the overall experience even better. It was fresh, warm, and served nicely. I really liked how filling it was without being too heavy. Overall, the food quality was great, and the vada pav stood out as the best item. I would definitely like to eat it again soon.

featured_reviews.name: Jugesh Gaud
featured_reviews.review_text: Changu Mangu Vada Pav was once known for its amazing taste, but unfortunately, it doesn’t feel the same anymore. Earlier, the vada pav had a unique flavor and freshness that made it special, but now the taste has changed and is not as enjoyable as it used to be.

featured_reviews.name: Nimesh Jotaniya
featured_reviews.review_text:

They also serve different types of bhajiya in the evening and vada, samosa through out day.
You must come to enjoy real a taste of Vadapav serve with 2 Chutney, dry Chutney and Chilly.

featured_reviews.name: Fabian Francis
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are in Dahisar, then this is hands down the best Misal Pav shack to visit. It has the right amount of spice and the combination with vada is the best, don’t shy away to ask for extra rassa. They also have idli vada sambhar which is good but not that great. In the end people flock here for their misal/vada pav which is enough to visit this place again and again. Their chaas after a delicious spicy meal is also good.

The Shop where the hotel is situated now earlier had another hotel named Pangat pure veg which was serving great cuisines and service. Now it has been replaced by this hotel.
The staff at Hasta are all non-professional under trained people. Paneer makhanwala was too high in tomato and thus being too sour.
Another concern is that even though they dont allow individuals above 5yr to share unlimited thali, they must be lenient with atleast old people sharing a thali as they dont have that much apetite to consume unlimited thali but still have a wish to get one. featured_reviews.name: Rudra Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a very disappointing experience at Hasta Restaurant. The place and ambience are actually good, but unfortunately the staff and management completely ruined the overall experience. First of all, the AC was barely working and the restaurant was feeling hot and uncomfortable throughout the visit. For a restaurant that expects customers to sit and enjoy their meal peacefully, proper cooling is the most basic thing, and they failed badly at that.
The biggest issue was the staff behavior. The restaurant seems extremely understaffed, because there were very few employees handling too many tables. Due to this, service was very slow and unorganized. On top of that, some staff members were very rude and careless while talking to customers. Simple requests had to be repeated multiple times and nobody seemed interested in helping properly.
What made the experience even worse was the manager’s attitude. Complaints regarding the AC and delayed service were ignored completely. The manager was not responding seriously and did not seem to care about customer satisfaction at all. Instead of solving issues, they just avoided responsibility.
Honestly, the hotel and interiors are good, but the staff management is one of the worst I have experienced. Good ambience means nothing if customers are treated poorly and basic comfort is ignored. Very disappointing experience overall and definitely not worth the money or time unless they improve their service, staff behavior, and management.

featured_reviews.name: prathamesh rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this restaurant recently and tried their seasonal thali, and it was a great experience. The food was super tasty, and every item in the thali was properly prepared and served with good presentation.
The staff was very welcoming, polite, and had a positive attitude, which made our visit even more enjoyable. We had a really good time here with our family.
Good food, good service, and a pleasant atmosphere — highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: CHIRANTAN SHAH
featured_reviews.review_text:
Do yourself a favour and stay far away from this place.

Extremely poorly managed, highly unreliable, and absolutely not worth anyone’s time or money.

This place is a perfect example of how NOT to run a food business. The restaurant is practically next door to my house, yet the delivery took an embarrassingly long time.

There is absolutely no excuse for this level of inefficiency.

No updates, no explanation, no apology — just silence and arrogance. It honestly feels like once they receive the order, they completely forget that a customer even exists.

If basic food delivery to nearby locations is such a struggle, then this restaurant should seriously rethink being on Zomato at all. This isn’t “delay,” this is sheer negligence and zero professionalism.

God knows how they treat dine-in customers if this is their online service quality.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Ordered via Zomato and had one of the worst food delivery experiences ever.
The hotel is literally very close to my house, yet they managed to deliver the food extremely late without any valid reason.

No update, no apology, no sense of urgency — just complete carelessness. If you can’t handle basic food orders even for nearby locations, you seriously shouldn’t be listed on delivery platforms.
